integrity: No independent external audit. Both programs are standalone reproducible standard-library implementations and have output artifacts. Results rely on proof of exhaustive coverage, not only small-order tests.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for KG(n,2), n at least four; finite exhaustive classification uses an analytically proven six-edge bound. Earlier minimum results and general set-pair inequality are not claimed as new. Classical unindexed edge-critical classifications may overlap. Source publication in 1993 is verified to the year, not to a public calendar day; 2014-07-08 is the qualifying day-resolved archival source.
title: All inclusion-minimal total dominators of \(\mathrm{KG}(n,2)\)
